qa_pairs.question: What information does the 'Mémoire' (Memory) graph provide on a GPU task page?
qa_pairs.answer: On a GPU task page, the 'Mémoire' (Memory) graph allows users to visualize the usage over time of the CPU memory they requested for their GPU task.

qa_pairs.question: How can I monitor the CPU memory usage allocated to my GPU tasks?
qa_pairs.answer: You can monitor the CPU memory usage allocated to your GPU tasks by viewing the 'Mémoire' (Memory) graph on the GPU task page, which illustrates its utilization over time.
